items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: And Marvin, Tram Martin, Justin Joss on the drum.

ctx.x: Now, this band you're playing at Leroy's on Burmese Street with, Dave, is that your band? You're leading that band? That's my band, yeah. Uh-huh. And you've got Sam Dutre in there? And who else is in the band with you?
Willie Joss, Josh Willis at least. You know Josh Willis the trumpet man? Uh-huh. And Marvin, Tram Martin, Justin Joss on the drum. And then McNeil Groh was on the bass.
Did you say also Kimball sometimes?
